answer: No—based on the provided evidence, I cannot determine what NVIDIA’s (NVDA) **closing price specifically on 31 December 2030** will be. The sources found are general “price forecast” or “target” articles, but none of the evidence includes an explicit, dated estimate for the **31 Dec 2030 closing price** (a single fixed calendar-day value). For example, Benzinga provides a multi-year 2026–2030 forecast without establishing a specific 31 Dec 2030 closing price [S6]. TradingView also provides a forecast/price-target view rather than a specific “31 December 2030 close” figure [S17].
